ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
be amended by changing all the B3-2 Community Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 5-M in the area bounded by
West Fullerton Avenue; a line 87 feet east of and parallel to North
MeVicker Avenue; a Public Alley south of and parallel to Fullerton
Avenue; and a line 57 feet east of and parallel to North McVicker Avenue;
to those of a B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District is hereby established in the

area above described.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 6019 West Fullerton Avenue
